limitations: Only Zelda own isolated neighboring-room simulation uses the new service. Active-room execution and unsupported byte sequences/read mappings/observers/interrupts/hooks/budgets retain the original routine. Other titles and modes are not claimed as newly measured gains.

The complete actual25-byte routine and13-byte helper are qualified, not an earlier guessed14-byte clear-only tail. The implemented memory prefix takes752/753 cycles; ordinary finalSTA and outerRTS complete the actual762/763-cycle routine. No guest budget cycles or required device/bus behavior are dropped.

The actual original CPU routine supplies the oracle. All256 cursor inputs vary flags/Y/stack;35 budget endpoints,38 full-range mutations and6 IRQ/policy/observer/read-gate refusals compare full2048RAM, returned registers, hardware hash and cycle count. InnerJSR stack writes and ADC/CMP/V flags are preserved.

Oracle binary53a2fec91acbcda1a0937fbb673e10020c3f1ac3eb2cd436f1bfebe3828c117d and measured29961a0c884469b6b02e5a713a2501d7bef81236b417457d970aaab8914f19a4 have identical four core source recipes. The only later source change is optional QA exit job-count reporting; its earlier source is reconstructed by hash and retained with the exact oracle executable. Normal builds leave ZELDA_TEST_NATIVE_JOBS off.

Supported CMake regeneration adds only hook metadata and one RAM-entry check;19 other generated sources are byte-identical. Frozen relinking replaces four original objects and adds the optional oracle, preserving118 other objects including Zelda canvas. This is not a claim of a complete fresh supported title/CLI build.

Actual600-frame matched trials on this PC use software SDL1280x720, Fit426x240/15rooms or Atlas4096x1472/128rooms, emulated/mixed dummy audio, fixed input and rewind100/4. Setup/load is excluded; normal shutdown included. All per-pair CPU/wall samples, negative observations, source/binary/settings and measured headroom are retained. No cross-profile pooling or universal gain claim.

Fit has two slower pairs and one faster pair and is neutral/inconclusive despite a positive raw median. Atlas is faster in all three measured pairs. No gain offsets a reproducible individual regression; future combined checks can still find one.

Diagnostic sampling has1313 successful owned-main-thread samples and2 failures,661 isolated samples and48 at guest dispatchPC6E1D. Dispatch PC/source attribution is coarse; it is neither exclusive CPU cost nor a recoverable bound or A/B result.

First oracle launcher omitted required exit-after with uncapped and exited2 before any TCP/gameplay; corrected launcher reused the same binary and passed. This is a retained QA setup exclusion, not an optimization failure.

NES08 earlier all-stock wording is corrected on PR87 at5898f5e: four stock256x240 titles plus Zelda Seamless Fit426x240. Original raw labels remain historical; matching samples/runtime/disposition are unchanged and were not rerun.

Other complete entity/collision/decompression/streaming services remain explicit residual opportunities. Scoped selection is not architectural exhaustion. FDS remains parked. Final supported CLI/five-title regeneration, combined feature/performance and owner visual approval remain pending; no merge or release.
